cover.lead: Yayasan MENDAKI and NUS High School of Mathematics and Science sign a three-year MOU to widen access and exposure to STEM for Malay/Muslim students.

about.body: MENDAKI and NUS High School will *widen access to STEM* for Malay/Muslim students, bringing together NUS High School's expertise in mathematics, science and research with MENDAKI's community and professional networks.

areas.title: STEM scholarships
areas.outcome: Financial support for students to pursue their interest in STEM

areas.title: Mentoring & networks
areas.outcome: Students learn from professionals in MENDAKI's networks

areas.title: Enrichment & outreach
areas.outcome: More youths get to discover maths, science and technology

quote.text: As technology continues to reshape our economy and the way we work, we want more Malay/Muslim students to see STEM as a pathway that is open to them.
